# Programming.Guide

> A comprehensive resource for learning programming languages, algorithms, and data structures with deep technical explanations and practical examples.

Programming.Guide provides in-depth tutorials and reference materials covering Java, Go, and fundamental computer science concepts. The site emphasizes language internals, concurrency patterns, algorithm design, and common pitfalls developers encounter.

## Key Topics

- Java
- Go
- Concurrency
- Data Structures
- Algorithms
- Big O Notation
- Interfaces
- Lambda Expressions
- Goroutines
- Channels
- Hash Tables
- Unicode
- Time Complexity
- Dynamic Programming
- Type System

## Language Fundamentals

- [Java](https://programming.guide/java/index.html): Index of all Java articles covering arrays, exceptions, types, and language features
- [Go](https://programming.guide/go/index.html): Index of Go tutorials, cheat sheets, and language reference

## Concurrency & Threading

- [Go: Concurrent programming](https://programming.guide/go/go-concurrency-tutorial.html): Comprehensive guide to Go concurrency: goroutines, channels, synchronization
- [Java: Why wait must be called in a synchronized block](https://programming.guide/java/why-wait-must-be-in-synchronized.html): Explains Java concurrency: synchronized blocks and wait-notify patterns
- [Java: Handling InterruptedException](https://programming.guide/java/handling-interrupted-exceptions.html): Tutorial on handling InterruptedException in Java threading

## Java Language Deep Dives

- [Java: Functional Interfaces](https://programming.guide/java/functional-interfaces.html): Guide to Java functional interfaces, lambda expressions, and method references
- [Java: Do interfaces inherit from Object?](https://programming.guide/java/do-interfaces-inherit-from-object.html): Explains Java interface inheritance from Object and related methods
- [Java: Executing code in comments?!](https://programming.guide/java/executing-code-in-comments.html): Explains Java Unicode escapes and code execution in comments

## Go Language Essentials

- [Go: For loops explained](https://programming.guide/go/for-loop.html): Tutorial on Go for loops, loop control flow, and break/continue
- [Go: Maps explained](https://programming.guide/go/maps-explained.html): Guide to using maps (hashmaps) and hash tables in Go
- [Go: String handling cheat sheet](https://programming.guide/go/string-functions-reference-cheat-sheet.html): Reference cheat sheet for Go string functions and Unicode handling
- [Go gotcha](https://programming.guide/go/go-gotcha.html): Tutorial covering common mistakes and corner cases in Go

## Algorithms & Data Structures

- [Algorithms](https://programming.guide/algorithms.html): Index of algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis articles
- [Big O notation explained](https://programming.guide/big-o-notation-explained.html): Guide to Big O notation and complexity analysis in algorithms
- [Dynamic programming vs memoization vs tabulation](https://programming.guide/dynamic-programming-vs-memoization-vs-tabulation.html): Explains dynamic programming techniques: memoization and tabulation
- [Sliding Window Algorithm with Example](https://programming.guide/sliding-window-example.html): Explains sliding window algorithm technique for data structures

## Program Correctness & Theory

- [What makes a good loop invariant?](https://programming.guide/what-makes-a-good-loop-invariant.html): Guide to loop invariants and Hoare logic for program correctness
- [Generating a random point within a circle (uniformly)](https://programming.guide/random-point-within-circle.html): Explains uniform random point generation within circles using sampling
